TABLE.NAME: local_tm_classroom
TABLE.COMMENT: Classrooms for session location and capacity

FIELD.NAME: tcms_location
FIELD.COMMENT: TCMS location label for this classroom (session sync)

FIELD.NAME: table_count
FIELD.COMMENT: Total tables/desks in this room

TABLE.NAME: local_tm_enabled_courses
TABLE.COMMENT: Moodle courses linked to TM session picker

FIELD.NAME: default_duration_hours
FIELD.COMMENT: Default session length (hours) for auto schedule when creating sessions

FIELD.NAME: default_duration_hours_onsite
FIELD.COMMENT: Default onsite duration (hours) for reservation/scheduling

FIELD.NAME: default_duration_hours_online
FIELD.COMMENT: Default online duration (hours) for reservation/scheduling

FIELD.NAME: allow_onsite
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if onsite reservation is allowed for this course

FIELD.NAME: allow_online
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if online reservation is allowed for this course

FIELD.NAME: allowed_classroomids
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated classroom ids applicable to this course

FIELD.NAME: online_classroomid
FIELD.COMMENT: Classroom for online reservation scheduling (teacher occupancy)

FIELD.NAME: default_prerequisite_rules
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON default prerequisite rules for new sessions of this course

FIELD.NAME: tcms_course_type
FIELD.COMMENT: TCMS courseTypes label for this course (session sync)

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Linked Moodle course id (mdl_course.id)

FIELD.NAME: classroomid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_tm_classroom.id; 0 = legacy session without classroom

FIELD.NAME: teaching_language
FIELD.COMMENT: en | zh_tw

FIELD.NAME: delivery_mode
FIELD.COMMENT: onsite | online

FIELD.NAME: meeting_link
FIELD.COMMENT: Online meeting URL (used when delivery_mode=online)

FIELD.NAME: starttime
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp

FIELD.NAME: endtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp

FIELD.NAME: duration_hours
FIELD.COMMENT: Actual hours needed (flexible)

FIELD.NAME: num_desks
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of desks (from classroom or legacy)

FIELD.NAME: persons_per_desk
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 to 3 persons per desk

FIELD.NAME: approval_mode
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=auto approve, 1=manual review

FIELD.NAME: prerequisite_courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Legacy single prerequisite course; superseded by prerequisite_rules

FIELD.NAME: prerequisite_rules
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON prerequisite rules: operator and rules array

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=open, 2=full, 0=closed

FIELD.NAME: auto_close_exempt
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=skip site registration auto-close rule for this session

FIELD.NAME: groupid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle group id auto-created for this session (mdl_groups.id)

FIELD.NAME: attendance_cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: mod_attendance course module id (mdl_course_modules.id)

FIELD.NAME: attendance_sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: mod_attendance session slot id (mdl_attendance_sessions.id)

FIELD.NAME: source_reservation_id
FIELD.COMMENT: FK local_tm_course_reservation.id when session created from dedicated-class approval

FIELD.NAME: session_kind
FIELD.COMMENT: standard | room_closed (classroom block, no enrolment)

FIELD.NAME: tcms_session_id
FIELD.COMMENT: TCMS sessions.id mirror when synced

FIELD.NAME: tcms_sync_status
FIELD.COMMENT: ok | pending | error | skipped

FIELD.NAME: tcms_sync_error
FIELD.COMMENT: Last TCMS sync error message

FIELD.NAME: tcms_sync_hash
FIELD.COMMENT: Content hash for reconcile

FIELD.NAME: tcms_last_synced
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time last successful TCMS sync

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=pending, 1=approved, 2=rejected, 3=cancelled, 4=waitlisted

FIELD.NAME: desk_number
FIELD.COMMENT: Assigned desk number (1..table_count); NULL until assigned

FIELD.NAME: attended
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=not attended, 1=attended (from mod_attendance)

FIELD.NAME: institution
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of user institution at time of enrolment

FIELD.NAME: diet_choice
FIELD.COMMENT: A=meat, B=vegetarian; empty when not collected (e.g. seat placeholders)

FIELD.NAME: diet_avoid_beef
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=avoid beef (meat option)

FIELD.NAME: diet_avoid_seafood
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=avoid seafood (meat option)

FIELD.NAME: diet_meat_other
FIELD.COMMENT: Other meat restrictions (free text)

FIELD.NAME: diet_vegetarian_notes
FIELD.COMMENT: Vegetarian remarks (free text)

FIELD.NAME: notes
FIELD.COMMENT: Admin notes (rejection reason, etc.)

FIELD.NAME: cancel_reason_code
FIELD.COMMENT: Cancellation reason code selected by learner

FIELD.NAME: cancel_reason_text
FIELD.COMMENT: Free-text cancellation reason when code is other

FIELD.NAME: batch_submittedby
FIELD.COMMENT: User id of business user who submitted batch enrolment (M4)

FIELD.NAME: batch_submitter_note
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional remark from submitter for this batch enrolment (same text per row in one submission)

FIELD.NAME: seat_company
FIELD.COMMENT: Company name for placeholder seat booking

FIELD.NAME: seat_note
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional note for placeholder seat booking

FIELD.NAME: placeholder_seq
FIELD.COMMENT: Placeholder sequence number in one batch

FIELD.NAME: placeholder_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Display name used for placeholder learner

FIELD.NAME: linked_userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Linked Moodle user id after follow-up email binding

FIELD.NAME: linked_email
FIELD.COMMENT: Latest email entered for follow-up linking

FIELD.NAME: sync_health
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=not checked,1=ok,3=error

FIELD.NAME: sync_lastcheck
FIELD.COMMENT: Last Unix timestamp of sync health check

FIELD.NAME: sync_statusjson
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON diagnostic payload for audit trail

FIELD.NAME: sync_error
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable latest sync issue summary

FIELD.NAME: batch_archived
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when submitter archived this batch tracking item

FIELD.NAME: vq_submission_id
FIELD.COMMENT: FK local_tm_course_sess_vq_sub.id when session pre-course verification applies

FIELD.NAME: reservation_initial_enrol
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when created from dedicated-class approval batch (not later batch_enrol)

FIELD.NAME: repeat_type
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=none, 1=weekly, 2=monthly

FIELD.NAME: session_ids
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of created session ids

TABLE.NAME: local_tm_course_perm_rule
TABLE.COMMENT: Rules granting batch enrol access by user profile match

FIELD.NAME: ruletype
FIELD.COMMENT: idnumber | institution | name_contains

TABLE.NAME: local_tm_perm_att_rule
TABLE.COMMENT: Rules granting attendance access by user profile match

FIELD.NAME: ruletype
FIELD.COMMENT: idnumber | institution | name_contains

FIELD.NAME: requesterid
FIELD.COMMENT: Applicant user id

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Requested linked Moodle course id

FIELD.NAME: courseids_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of requested course ids for stacked reservation flow

FIELD.NAME: delivery_mode
FIELD.COMMENT: onsite | online

FIELD.NAME: teaching_language
FIELD.COMMENT: en | zh_tw

FIELD.NAME: classroomid
FIELD.COMMENT: Required when delivery_mode=onsite

FIELD.NAME: preferred_classroomid
FIELD.COMMENT: Applicant preferred classroom for onsite reservations

FIELD.NAME: preferred_meeting_link
FIELD.COMMENT: Meeting link requested when delivery_mode=online

FIELD.NAME: preferred_starttime
FIELD.COMMENT: Requested start timestamp

FIELD.NAME: preferred_endtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Computed target end timestamp

FIELD.NAME: learner_source
FIELD.COMMENT: manual | excel | group

FIELD.NAME: cohortid
FIELD.COMMENT: Selected cohort id when learner_source=group

FIELD.NAME: excel_filename
FIELD.COMMENT: Uploaded excel/csv original filename when learner_source=excel

FIELD.NAME: disclaimer_snapshot
FIELD.COMMENT: Disclaimer text shown when application created

FIELD.NAME: calendar_plan_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of planned blocks after interactive calendar (Phase 4)

FIELD.NAME: calendar_onboarding_seen
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 after user dismissed first-visit onboarding on calendar

FIELD.NAME: calendar_plan_submitted
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 after applicant submitted schedule for review (still pending admin)

FIELD.NAME: archived
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when requester archived this custom request in tracking list

FIELD.NAME: application_submitted
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=draft (steps 1-3 in progress); 1=formally submitted at step 3

FIELD.NAME: timesubmitted
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time when application_submitted became 1; used as applied-at in tracking

FIELD.NAME: online_daily_hours_limit
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional per-application cap (hours/day) used to evenly split online courses across consecutive workdays. NULL or 0 = no manual split.

FIELD.NAME: batch_submitter_note
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional remark from batch full-list on dedicated class application

TABLE.NAME: local_tm_course_resv_learner
TABLE.COMMENT: Learner rows attached to dedicated class request

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Existing Moodle user id if matched

FIELD.NAME: diet_choice
FIELD.COMMENT: A=meat, B=vegetarian from batch full-list

FIELD.NAME: source_type
FIELD.COMMENT: manual | batch_full | excel | group

TABLE.NAME: local_tm_course_vq_file
TABLE.COMMENT: Uploaded verification files for reservation questions

TABLE.NAME: local_tm_course_sess_vq_sub
TABLE.COMMENT: Session enrolment verification submission (self or batch)

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: self | batch

FIELD.NAME: actor_userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Learner (self) or batch submitter user id

FIELD.NAME: submitted
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 after applicant finished upload step

TABLE.NAME: local_tm_course_sess_vq_file
TABLE.COMMENT: Uploaded verification files for session submission

TABLE.NAME: local_tm_equip_check_item
TABLE.COMMENT: Equipment check item templates configured per course

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: onsite | online | both

FIELD.NAME: checktype
FIELD.COMMENT: status (正常/異常+備註) | task (完成/未完成)

FIELD.NAME: itemname
FIELD.COMMENT: Display text for this checklist item

TABLE.NAME: local_tm_equip_check_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Equipment check results per session per desk per item

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK local_tm_course_sessions.id

FIELD.NAME: desknumber
FIELD.COMMENT: 1..num_desks for onsite; always 1 for online (instructor's own set)

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK local_tm_equip_check_item.id

FIELD.NAME: checkstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=unset/incomplete, 1=normal/complete, 2=abnormal (status type only)

FIELD.NAME: remark
FIELD.COMMENT: Free-text note, mainly used for abnormal status items

FIELD.NAME: checkedby
FIELD.COMMENT: mdl_user.id who last saved this row
